provenance: Actual RPC observations when collected by the app; deterministic fixtures must be labeled separately. Calldata omitted for sharing.

findings.title: eth_chainId: evidence unavailable
findings.detail: RPC timed out. Evidence is incomplete; retry or switch provider.
findings.nextStep: Retry or choose another provider. Successful checks in this report remain visible.

explanation.checked: Read-only RPC response availability, validated shape, or sampled block views; see the rule ID and evidence references for this check.
explanation.unknown: A failed request cannot distinguish a provider outage from local connectivity. Sequential samples are not an atomic snapshot; freshness depends on the server clock.
explanation.why: Incomplete or stale evidence can make an integration appear healthy or broken without enough support.
explanation.verify: Retry RPC health with the same provider and compare the second provider. Inspect new timestamps, chain ID and finalized/latest evidence. Confirm the specific warning clears; elapsed time alone proves nothing.

error.message: Evidence unavailable; consult the diagnostic finding and retry.
